text: BAM share fell 0.07 percentage points over 21 hours, while remaining up 0.23 percentage points over 7 days at 34.5% of all Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 21.8% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. Recent top-node movement should be read as whale-driven routing, not evidence of a new structural rollover.
